name: Tenkarrdun crater
title: Tenkarrdun
summary: Tenkarrdun is the huge crater in the middle of Aerlinthe where the Tenkarrdun Hellfire and the Behemoth spawn. The kit shows a bowl ~300 m across: an obsidian-and-lava floor (z 93-97) rising to walls of 140-215 m and to 398 m at the north rim, with three Volcanic Vents and glowing red sphere lamps, Volcano Heat and Erupt Tenkarrdun emitters on the floor. Landblocks south of y 46080, west of x 35328 and east of x 35904 are missing from the kit; all cameras stay on the north side.

landmarks.name: West vent
landmarks.note: Volcanic Vent + glowing red sphere lamp.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch2).

shots.standingOrder: Spiral down 32 deg counter-clockwise into the crater from 60 m to 24 m above the vents, radius 90 m to 58 m, on its north side; keep 9 m above the crater floor and 35 m from the vents.
shots.notes: Descent into Tenkarrdun, the huge volcanic crater in the middle of Aerlinthe: the bowl's obsidian walls rise 100-300 m around a floor of volcanic vents that glow red and breathe heat (Volcano Heat, Erupt Tenkarrdun emitters). From the north the high noon sun backlights the vents' haze.
